# Link: `jl-link`

A link in text, a list or a footer, with safe external links.

- Class `JlLink`, an atom: `import { JlLink } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/link

A link is the browser's own <a>, styled: it goes somewhere, where a button does something. In running
text, keep the default variant: its underline tells it apart without colour. quiet suits lists and cards, where
the context says it is a link; muted suits footers and secondary navigation.

external opens the page in a new tab, without giving it a handle on this one (rel="noopener noreferrer"), and says
so with an icon and, for screen readers, with words.

An app that navigates in code (a router's goto) makes the link interactive and gives it no href: followed by a click
or Enter, it fires press, and the app goes there. It stays a link to the keyboard and to screen readers.

## Use

```ts
import { JlLink } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlLink href="https://github.com/bioleyl/jadis" label="Read the docs" />
```

```html
<jl-link href="https://github.com/bioleyl/jadis" label="Read the docs"></jl-link>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `href` (attribute `href`): `string`, default `''`. Where it goes.
- `label` (attribute `label`): `string`, default `''`. The text, when there is no slotted content.
- `variant` (attribute `variant`): `'default' | 'quiet' | 'muted'`, default `'default'`. Underlined accent, accent underlined on hover, or secondary text.
- `external` (attribute `external`): `boolean`, default `false`. Opens in a new tab with rel="noopener noreferrer", and shows an icon.
- `target` (attribute `target`): `string`, default `''`. Where it opens, as the target of an <a>; external links default to _blank.
- `interactive` (attribute `interactive`): `boolean`, default `false`. Without an href, fires press when followed, for the app to go there itself.

## Events

In JSX, the `on…` prop, its handler given the detail; in code, `events.register(name, (detail) => …)`. They do not bubble.

- `press` (`onPress` in JSX), detail `undefined`: An interactive link without an href was followed.

## Slots

- The default slot: The text, with markup if needed.

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The <a> inside.
- `--color` (custom property): The text colour.
- `--hover` (custom property): The text colour under the pointer.
- `--underline` (custom property): The underline colour at rest.

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### Variants

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-link href="#/components/link" label="Default"></jl-link>
  <jl-link href="#/components/link" label="Quiet" variant="quiet"></jl-link>
  <jl-link href="#/components/link" label="Muted" variant="muted"></jl-link>
</div>
```

### External

Opens in a new tab, safely, with an icon that says so.

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-link href="https://github.com/bioleyl/jadis" label="Jadis on GitHub" external></jl-link>
  <jl-link href="https://lucide.dev" label="Lucide icons" variant="quiet" external></jl-link>
</div>
```

### In text

Links take the size of the text around them.

```html
<p>jlib is built on <jl-link href="https://github.com/bioleyl/jadis" external>Jadis</jl-link>, a thin layer over
native Web Components. Read the <jl-link href="#/getting-started">getting started guide</jl-link>, then browse
<jl-link href="#/components">all components</jl-link>.</p>
```

### In a footer

```html
<div class="row muted">
  <span>© 2026 jlib</span>
  <jl-link href="#/" label="Privacy" variant="muted"></jl-link>
  <jl-link href="#/" label="Terms" variant="muted"></jl-link>
  <jl-link href="#/" label="Status" variant="muted"></jl-link>
</div>
```

### Followed by the app

No href: the app follows the link itself, as a router would with goto.

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-link class="demo-followed" label="Open order #3" interactive></jl-link>
  <span class="muted demo-followed-note">Not followed yet</span>
</div>
```

```js
const link = root.querySelector('.demo-followed');
link.events.register('press', () => {
  root.querySelector('.demo-followed-note').textContent = 'Followed: the app goes to order #3';
});
```
